say:1:1641115001:1.text: Water never stays the same for long.

say:2:1641115002:1.text: One moment it's a stream, the next it's mist, or ice, or rain.
say:2:1641115002:1.source_cn: 液体、雾气、冰晶……它们之间是可以转变的。

say:3:1641115003:1.text: If I could get my magic to do the same—change states in an instant—I might finally create a spell that attacks and defends in the same breath.
say:3:1641115003:1.source_cn: 如果我能让魔力在瞬间完成类似的变化，那么这个魔法就能兼...

say:4:1641115004:1.text: The trouble is... I can't channel the energy fast enough. It scatters the moment it hits the water.
say:4:1641115004:1.source_cn: 可惜……速度不够。魔力在水流里散开，完全无法聚拢。

say:5:1641115005:1.text: Maybe my control isn't precise enough... or maybe I've been barking up the wrong tree altogether.
say:5:1641115005:1.source_cn: 是我控制得还不够精细？还是说，从一开始方向就错了……

say:6:1641115006:1.text: Wha—Magister Merlin?! How long have you been standing there? Sorry... I got a little too absorbed in a magical problem and didn't notice you.
say:6:1641115006:1.source_cn: 唔？——梅林大人！您什么时候在这里的？对不起……我刚刚...
say:6:1641115006:1.male: Wha—Magister Merlin?! How long have you been standing there? Sorry... I got a little too absorbed in a magical problem and didn't notice you.
say:6:1641115006:1.female: Wha—Magister Merlin?! How long have you been standing there? Sorry... I got a little too absorbed in a magical problem and didn't notice you.

say:7:1641115007:1.text: Oh! By the way, my mother's making pancakes nearby. Stick around, I'll save you one!
say:7:1641115007:1.source_cn: 啊，对了，我妈妈正在煎松饼，一会儿一起尝尝吧。
say:7:1641115007:1.male: Oh! By the way, my mother's making pancakes nearby. Stick around, I'll save you one!
say:7:1641115007:1.female: Oh! By the way, my mother's making pancakes nearby. Stick around, I'll save you one!
